summary: Preinstall dropper downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and immediately invokes it to run a sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated bundle using a string-array rotation scheme (shuffle function pushing/shifting the array `n7gIxM`, decoder `hc1jfK9`, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header). `setup.mjs` itself uses hex-mangled identifiers (`_0x488df8`, etc.). The package is published as a Jest preset (`@ornikar/jest-config-react-native`); pulling a second language runtime at install time to execute a large obfuscated bundle is unrelated to a Jest configuration package's stated purpose. The alternate runtime is used specifically to run the payload outside of Node, evading Node-based supply-chain scanners. The preinstall lifecycle fires automatically on `npm install`, yielding install-time code execution on the installer's machine driven by opaque code shipped in the tarball.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
